title: The Chain Graph of a general Iterated Function System
summary: Classical fractal geometry describes the metric and topological structure of attractors generated by contractive Iterated Function Systems (IFSs). Much less is known about their global qualitative dynamics once the contractive hypothesis is abandoned. In this article we focus on IFSs with "compact dynamics", namely those IFSs for which there exists a non-empty compact set invariant under the Hutchinson map that attracts every compact subset of the phase space.
